categories.evidence: Modifies compact block reconstruction handling and diagnostics in src/net_processing.cpp and src/blockencodings.cpp.
categories.rationale: Improves diagnostic logging and metrics accounting during compact block reconstruction without altering relay behavior or network protocol logic. Diagnostic logging changes sink in priority under general criteria, though it provides minor leverage for observing block reconstruction in the context of the #35558 prefill series.
